I'll start by inspecting the project layout and the build contract.

That shell call was malformed. I'll write the makefile fragments directly instead.

That call was malformed too. I'll reissue it complete: fix the `neg` operand precedence, then check whether a static link works.

The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md`, and I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

I checked each target as the only target on a clean tree with `make -j8`: the library, both programs, `check`, `install` and `all`. A clean `-j8` build also passed five times in a row. I didn't run `make install` under a DEBUG build.

- **`make check`:** 22 unit tests and 34 golden cases pass, in both the release build and `make DEBUG=1`. `check` now runs both suites and fails if either fails. It used to ignore failures.
- **`make DEBUG=1`:** the debug flags were never applied, because the makefile tested for `DEBUG=yes`. Objects and programs now rebuild when the flags or `CC` change, so switching between debug and release in one tree works.
- **Incremental builds:** a second `make` runs no compile, archive or link step. Touching a source file, a header, `VERSION` or `src/ops.def` rebuilds what depends on it.
- **Install:** the installed tree matches section 8, including both man pages and the generated `version.h`. `qs.pc` is written at install time, so it records the `PREFIX` given to `make install`. A small program built against the installed header and library works.

What was wrong and what I changed:

- **Generated headers:** `version.h` had no generation rule. A stale hand-written `include/qs/ops.h` sat in the source tree and was missing `hypot` and `clamp`. I deleted it. Both headers are now generated into `build/gen`.
- **Link line:** the libraries were in the wrong place on the link line, and the programs didn't depend on `libqs.a`. Both are fixed. I added `-static` to the two program links because the contract says they link statically against the math library. That works here because `libc.a` and `libm.a` are installed.
- **Warnings:** I fixed every warning in both configurations in the code, with no pragmas or `-Wno-*` flags. The only fix that needed care was the column lookup in `colstat`. I compare against `idx >= 0` rather than casting, so an unknown column still exits 2.
- **Size parsing:** `--max-size` with a value that overflows is now rejected as an invalid size. Before, it wrapped around silently.
- **`qcalc` precedence:** a prefix `-` now takes as its operand only operators that bind strictly tighter than `neg`, as `docs/qcalc.md` says. With the current `ops.def` nothing changes (`-2^2` is `-4`, `-3*2` is `-6`). It matters if `neg`'s precedence in `src/ops.def` is ever changed.

One ambiguity in `docs/colstat.md` I left as it was. Without `-c`, a header with a repeated name reports each column from its own data. With `-c a` it uses the first column named `a`.

command_result.command: cd /app && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | head -100 && cat docs/BUILDING.md && git status 2>&1 | head -3
cd /app && find . -type f -not -path './tests/golden/*' | sort; ls -la; cat Makefile; ls mk; cat mk/* ; cat build-aux/*; cat src/ops.def; cat VERSION qs.pc.in; cat docs/colstat.md docs/qcalc.md
cd /app && cat tests/golden.sh tests/unit/unit.h tests/unit/runner.c; cat include/qs/*.h; ls tests/golden | head -5; cat tests/golden/colstat-opt-01.cmd tests/golden/qcalc-opt-02.cmd
cd /app && rm include/qs/ops.h && for f in lib/core/*.c lib/csv/*.c lib/num/*.c lib/stats/*.c; do echo "=== $f"; cat -A $f | sed 's/\$$//' | head -0; cat $f; done
cd /app && for f in lib/expr/* lib/ops/*.c; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app && for f in tools/*/* tests/unit/test_*.c; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
cd /app && cat tools/qcalc/main.c | tail -20; cat tools/qcalc/qcalc.h tools/qcalc/repl.c; cat man/*; grep -c . tests/golden/*.cmd | head -0; cat tests/golden/qcalc-0[1-4].{cmd,in,out}
cd /app && make -j8 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|warning|Error' | head -50

cd /app && sed -i 's/static void reserve(struct qs_strbuf \*sb, size_t extra, const char \*caller)/static void reserve(struct qs_strbuf *sb, size_t extra)/; s/\(reserve(sb, [^,]*\), "[a-z]*")/\1)/; s/#include <stdio.h>/#include <stdio.h>\n#include <stdlib.h>/' lib/core/strbuf.c && grep -n 'reserve\|include' lib/core/strbuf.c; make -k -j8 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|warning' ; make -k -j8 DEBUG=1 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|warning'

cd /app && make clean >/dev/null && make -j8 >/tmp/b.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -E 'error:|warning:' /tmp/b.log; make -j8 check 2>&1 | grep -v '^gcc' | grep -v PASS | tail -40; echo rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

cd /app && grep -rn 'QS_DEBUG\|NDEBUG\|assert\|pragma' lib tools include tests/unit | grep -v '^tests/unit/unit.h'; cat build/gen/qs/version.h | head -12; build/bin/qcalc --ops; echo '-2^2' | build/bin/qcalc; echo '-3*2' | build/bin/qcalc; ldd build/bin/colstat
cd /app && ls /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.a /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libm.a; echo 'int main(void){return 0;}' > /tmp/t.c && gcc -static /tmp/t.c -lm -o /tmp/t && echo static-ok

cd /app && sed -i 's/\$(CC) \$(LDFLAGS) \$(COLSTAT_OBJS)/$(CC) -static $(LDFLAGS) $(COLSTAT_OBJS)/; s/\$(CC) \$(LDFLAGS) \$(QCALC_OBJS)/$(CC) -static $(LDFLAGS) $(QCALC_OBJS)/' mk/tools.mk && grep -n static mk/tools.mk && make clean >/dev/null && make -j8 >/tmp/b.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -E 'error:|warning:' /tmp/b.log; echo '-2^2' | build/bin/qcalc; file build/bin/qcalc | cut -c1-120; echo second:; make 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /app && tail -15 /tmp/b.log

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('mk/config.mk').read()
s=s.replace("\t@$(file >$@.new,$(FLAGS_TEXT))\n", "\t@printf '%s\\n' '$(subst ','\\'',$(FLAGS_TEXT))' > $@.new\n")
open('mk/config.mk','w').write(s)
EOF
sed -n 40,50p mk/config.mk; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do make clean >/dev/null; make -j8 >/tmp/b.log 2>&1 || { echo FAIL; tail -5 /tmp/b.log; }; done; grep -E 'error:|warning:' /tmp/b.log; echo '-2^2' | build/bin/qcalc; make 2>&1 | tail -3

cd /app && make -n | head; for t in build/lib/libqs.a build/bin/colstat build/bin/qcalc check install all; do make clean >/dev/null; rm -rf /tmp/st; make -j8 $t DESTDIR=/tmp/st PREFIX=/usr >/tmp/b.log 2>&1; echo "$t rc=$?"; done; echo ---; make -n | head -3; 
make -j8 DEBUG=1 2>&1 | grep -c 'DQS_DEBUG'; make DEBUG=1 -n | head -3; build/bin/qcalc -e '1+2'; make -j8 | grep -c gcc; make -n| head -3

cd /app && c=build/bin/colstat; printf 'a,b,a
1,x,5
2
"3" ,4,6
' > /tmp/i.csv; $c /tmp/i.csv; echo rc=$?; $c -c b,a,a /tmp/i.csv; $c -c zz /tmp/i.csv; echo rc=$?; $c --max-size 5 /tmp/i.csv; echo rc=$?; $c --max-size 1k /tmp/i.csv >/dev/null; echo rc=$?; $c --max-size 99999999999999999999g /tmp/i.csv; echo rc=$?; printf '' | $c; echo rc=$?; $c /nonexist; echo rc=$?; $c -d xx /tmp/i.csv; echo rc=$?; build/bin/qcalc -e '-2^2 + 3*-4'; build/bin/qcalc -e 'clamp(5,1,3)+hypot(3,4)'; build/bin/qcalc -e 'min(1)'; build/bin/qcalc -e '1/0'; echo rc=$?

cd /app && make clean >/dev/null && cat > STATUS.json <<'EOF'
{"status": "success", "summary": "Rewrote the makefiles (generated version.h/ops.h rules, dependency tracking, flag stamp for DEBUG=1, correct link order with -static, check that fails on any failure, install with per-run qs.pc and both man pages), deleted the stale hand-written include/qs/ops.h, and fixed all -Wall -Wextra warnings in both configurations without changing behavior (also made prefix-minus bind per ops.def). Verified clean -j8 builds of every target, make check, install into a DESTDIR, DEBUG=1, and incremental/no-op rebuilds."}
EOF
cat STATUS.json; ls
